text: The Rangitata River 2019 Flood Recovery initiative was launched in response to a historic flood event in December 2019 in Canterbury, New Zealand. The program, led by Environment Canterbury, aims to restore, strengthen, and adapt flood protection systems along the Rangitata River. It combines engineered structures with natural infrastructure and scientific guidance to enhance resilience against future flooding events. The initiative is part of a broader regional flood-resilience program and involves multiple public and private partners.
